label: Extended Tab Waistband
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: 474x711 px close-up colour photo of the front-quarter waist of grey high-rise trousers worn with a pale blue shirt. At 4x the waistband shows, left to right: a two-prong metal buckle side adjuster with a chevron-pointed cloth strap threaded through it; then a mitred waistband extension outlined by stitching (a pentagon whose point drops to the waistband's lower edge) carrying a dark horn button, with the tail of its horizontal buttonhole visible just outboard of the button, i.e. the tab is buttoned. No belt loops anywhere on the waistband. Waistband depth about 90 px, giving roughly 20 px/cm; the closure sits about 1 cm to the hip side of the pressed front crease and therefore several cm off the centre front, which is further toward the frame's right.

239x358 px close-up colour photo of the left front-quarter waist of grey herringbone high-rise trousers, the wearer's hand in the front pocket. At 7x with contrast boosted: a metal buckle side adjuster at the side seam (far left), then a deep waistband carrying TWO vertically stacked horn buttons, each with the tail of a horizontal buttonhole visible immediately to its right, and a clean vertical finished edge of the overlapping tab about 1.2 cm inboard of those buttonholes. No belt loops. Scale from the waistband depth is about 8 px/cm; the tab edge and buttons sit roughly 4-8 cm to the hip side of the estimated centre front (taken from the pleat/crease position), so the closure is displaced away from the fly as the option requires.
